actual_scope: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
bottleneck_link: While the complex side binds in the selected result (kappa = 0.001672660197076918, #1094) and scalar ADD reductions alone do not alter the paid profile {1:1323, 2:1342, 3:79, 4:44, 5:102, 6:11, 7:19} (rank mass 5,129), unifying the twisted H2-tw/H4-tw/K-tw star contract (#1868), the H5-tw deferred target-basis ideal (#2115), one-slot multicolumn scatter interleaving (#2440), the cyclic 5-helper basis change (#1709), and 6 new disjoint middle-column helper shears (-60 ADDs) breaks the 10,000-ADD barrier on R439 at 9,974 ADDs (-518 vs #1188, -74 vs #2440) while closing the open structural questions of #1937 (whole-section-A and post-first-read coupled star absorption), #2828 (all-length, all-workspace n_b >= 6 and cone-free optimality of (4,6,4) in F2[UT4(F2)]), and #2613/#2977 (dyadic full-Borel Grassmannian Schubert-cell parity floor sum rank_Q(A_j) >= 4 = mW at m=2, W=2).
stop_rule: Stop after verifying exact 661-column forward/reverse linear semantics and local/nine-stage guard bits (91 <= 104, 174 <= 192) for the 9,974-ADD 6-way R439 composition, proving the Whole-Section-A and coupled (a,c) star-absorption impossibility (5 solvable / 231 obstructed edges per word across PR1062, PR1122, PR1188 with 693 explicit 661-bit RREF dual hyperplane witnesses), proving the all-length n_b >= 6 exclusion and cone-free global optimality of (4,6,4) across all 3,600 zero-sum five-b middles in F2[UT4(F2)], proving the dyadic full-Borel Grassmannian Schubert-cell parity floor across all 20,224 3-call rank-1 parity systems over GL_4(Q), and verifying all 6 behavioral negative controls.
